Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Gorz the Emissary of Darkness
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc:
When you take damage from a card in your opponent's possession: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You must control no cards to activate and to resolve this effect. If Summoned this way, activate the appropriate effect, based on the type of damage:
● Battle damage: Special Summon 1 "Emissary of Darkness Token" (Fairy-Type/LIGHT/Level 7/ATK ?/DEF ?). Its ATK and DEF are each equal to the amount of battle damage you took.
● Effect damage: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of damage you took.

Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Herald of Perfection
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Dawn of the Herald". During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect: You can send 1 Fairy-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Naturia Barkion
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc:
1 EARTH Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner EARTH monsters 
During either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can banish 2 cards from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Ghost/Gold Rare.name: Solemn Judgment
Ghost/Gold Rare.desc: When a monster(s) would be Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Pay half your LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

Common.name: Bone Crusher
Common.desc: When this card is Special Summoned from your Graveyard by the effect of a Zombie-Type monster: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. During the End Phase of the turn this card was Special Summoned: Destroy it.

Common.name: Book of Life
Common.desc: Target 1 Zombie monster in your GY and 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon the first target, also banish the second target.

Common.name: Call of the Mummy
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: Copy Knight
Common.desc: When a Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster is Normal Summoned to your side of the field: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster with the same name and Level as the Normal Summoned monster (Warrior-Type/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)

Common.name: Dark Mimic LV1
Common.desc:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Dark Mimic LV3
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Draw 1 card, but if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Mimic LV1", draw 2 cards instead.

Common.name: Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow
Common.desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 card on the field; return that target to the hand.
● Look at the top card of their Deck, then return it to the top or bottom of the Deck.

Common.name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
Common.desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

Common.name: Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong
Common.desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.
● Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

Common.name: Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
Common.desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Add 1 "Dark Scorpion" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 "Dark Scorpion" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Dark Scorpion Burglars
Common.desc: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent sends 1 Spell Card from their Deck to the Graveyard.

Common.name: Dawn of the Herald
Common.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Herald of Perfection". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal exactly 6. When "Herald of Perfection" is Ritual Summoned by this card's effect: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 of the monsters in your Graveyard that was Tributed for that Ritual Summon; return that target to your hand.

Common.name: Despair from the Dark
Common.desc: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

Common.name: Don Zaloog
Double Coston
Common.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.

Common.name: Embodiment of Apophis
Common.desc: During either player's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Reptile-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1600/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)

Common.name: Fear from the Dark
Common.desc: When this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

Common.name: Gernia
Common.desc: During your next Standby Phase, after this face-up card you control was destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon it.

Common.name: Goblin Zombie
Common.desc: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 Zombie monster with 1200 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Helpoemer
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle: Make your opponent discard 1 random card. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: Hidden Spellbook
Common.desc: During your turn: Target 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into the Deck.

Common.name: Machine King - 3000 B.C.
Common.desc: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) You cannot Normal or Special Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Tribute 1 Machine-Type monster; this card gains ATK equal to the ATK the Tributed monster had on the field, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
Common.desc: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

Common.name: Patrician of Darkness
Common.desc: You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks.

Common.name: Physical Double
Common.desc: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 "Mirage Token" with the same Level, Type, Attribute, ATK, and DEF as that target. Destroy this Token during the End Phase.

Common.name: Pyramid of Wonders
Common.desc: All Zombie monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. If exactly 1 Zombie monster you control (and no other cards) would be destroyed, you can send this card to the GY instead.

Common.name: Pyramid Turtle
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

Common.name: Red Ogre
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send any number of cards from your hand to the Graveyard, then target the same number of cards on the field; return those targets to the hand.

Common.name: Regenerating Mummy
Common.desc: When this card is sent from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Return this card to the hand.

Common.name: Ryu Kokki
Common.desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled a Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster: Destroy that monster.

Common.name: Spellbook Organization
Common.desc: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then return them to the top of the Deck in any order.

Common.name: The Lady in Wight
Common.desc: Face-up Level 3 or lower Zombie-Type monsters on the field, except "The Lady in Wight", cannot be destroyed by battle and are unaffected by Spell/Trap effects. This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard.

Common.name: Tiki Curse
Common.desc: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Rock-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 1000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While this card is an Effect Monster, if another Trap Card that is a monster battles an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: Destroy that opponent's monster.

Common.name: Tiki Soul
Common.desc: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Rock-Type/LIGHT/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While this card is an Effect Monster, if another Trap Card you control that is a monster would be destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard, you can Set it in the Spell & Trap Card Zone instead.

Common.name: Vampire Lady
Common.desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard.

Common.name: Zoma the Spirit
Common.desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap.) If this card Summoned this way is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

Common.name: Zombie Master
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in either GY; Special Summon that target. This monster must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Gold Rare.name: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Gold Rare.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
You can discard any number of cards to the GY, then target the same number of cards your opponent controls; return those cards to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

Gold Rare.name: Call of the Haunted
Gold Rare.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Gold Rare.name: Dark Hole
Gold Rare.desc: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Gold Rare.name: Fabled Grimro
Gold Rare.desc: If you control a "Fabled" monster: You can send this card from your hand to the GY; add 1 "Fabled" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Fabled Grimro".

Gold Rare.name: Formula Synchron
Gold Rare.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw 1 card. Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control.

Gold Rare.name: Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World
Gold Rare.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your Graveyard) by returning 1 "Dark World" monster you control to the hand, except "Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World". If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then, if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand, then, if it was a monster, you can Special Summon it to your side of the field.

Gold Rare.name: Karakuri Steel Shogun mdl 00X "Bureido"
Gold Rare.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Machine-Type monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Karakuri" monster from your Deck. Once per turn, when the battle position of a face-up "Karakuri" monster you control is changed (and remains face-up): Draw 1 card.

Gold Rare.name: Master Hyperion
Gold Rare.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 "The Agent" monster from your hand, field, or Graveyard. Once per turn: You can banish 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target. While "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, you can activate this effect up to twice per turn.

Gold Rare.name: Naturia Beast
Gold Rare.desc:
1 EARTH Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner EARTH monsters 
When a Spell Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Gold Rare.name: Number 39: Utopia
Gold Rare.desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
When a monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the attack. If this card is targeted for an attack, while it has no material: Destroy this card.

Gold Rare.name: Sephylon, the Ultimate Timelord
Gold Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 10 or more monsters in your GY. Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or higher Fairy monster from your hand or GY, but its effects are negated, also its ATK becomes 4000.

Gold Rare.name: Starlight Road
Gold Rare.desc: When a card or effect is activated that would destroy 2 or more cards you control: Negate the effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then you can Special Summon 1 "Stardust Dragon" from your Extra Deck.
